description: This file is a front-end React-like component built with Qwik, representing the homepage of a Tic Tac Toe web application. It displays a welcome message, description, and navigation buttons to 'Play Now' and 'Leaderboard', with metadata for the page head.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: A function to define a reactive component in Qwik that renders the homepage UI.
